title: Session
description: Session events (ACP-style session/update), session input and session metadata.

SessionEventRecord.description: Payload of the session.events topic: one row of the session event log.

seq.description: Per-session sequence number, starting at 1, gap-free.

SessionEvent.description: Everything that happens in a session. Views must ignore types they don't know.

UserMessage.description: User input as typed, without injected event tags. Starts a turn.

shown.description: What the chat shows in place of text, when text is written for the agent: a button pressed in a neoui doc shows its message, the agent gets what was pressed and the form's values.

images.description: Absolute paths of attached images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP).

AgentMessageChunk.description: Streamed piece of the agent's visible reply.

messageId.description: Groups chunks of one assistant message.

agent.description: Set when a guest agent wrote it (e.g. claude, codex); absent for the session's own agent.

AgentThoughtChunk.description: Streamed piece of the agent's reasoning.

agent.description: Set when a guest agent wrote it (e.g. claude, codex); absent for the session's own agent.

ToolCall.description: The agent started a tool call.

tool.description: The tool's name; for tools_call, the connector tool (app.tool). Picks the result's view template.

rawInput.description: Tool arguments as sent by the model.

agent.description: Set when a guest agent wrote it (e.g. claude, codex); absent for the session's own agent.

ToolCallUpdate.description: Progress or result of a tool call. Fields that are present replace earlier values.

title.description: A better title, once the input is known.

rawInput.description: Tool arguments, when they arrive after the call started.

ToolKind.description: ACP tool kinds; lets views pick an icon or layout.

ImageContent.description: An image a tool returned (neo's read of a picture, an adapter's image block), for views to show. src is a file path or an asset:// handle; the bytes stay out of the log.

DiffContent.description: A file change. oldText is absent for new files.

TurnEnded.description: The turn started by the last user_message is over.

AppConnected.description: A connector registered, came back, or changed its tools (new v). Rendered to the model as <app connected=…/> the first time, <app reconnected=…/> for the same version, <app updated=… added=… removed=…/> for a new one. tools is always the full current list.

v.description: Connector version; bumps when its tools change.

description.description: One line about the connector; only in the first app_connected a session gets for it.

components.description: What to write to use the neoui components the connector offers, `photo-editor.BrightnessCard` (ui_library has their signatures). The full current list: with the first app_connected a session gets for it when there are any, and with an update when it changed (empty: it has none now). Rendered as components=….

reconnect.description: The session already saw this exact version: earlier schemas still apply. Rendered as <app reconnected=…/>.

added.description: Tools new since the previous version (omitted when none).

removed.description: Tools gone since the previous version (omitted when none).

previous.description: Set when the session knew an earlier version: that version. Rendered as <app updated=…/>; added/removed list the difference (omitted when empty).

AppDisconnected.description: A connector went away. Rendered to the model as <app disconnected=…/>.

FocusChanged.description: The user's focus moved. Rendered to the model as <focus app=… …context/>.

context.description: Extra attributes, e.g. url or project.

HarnessMessage.description: A complete message in the harness's native format. Views ignore it; the harness rebuilds its context from these after a restart.

harness.description: Which harness wrote it, e.g. neo.

message.description: Opaque to everyone but that harness.

images.description: Absolute paths of attached images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP).

title.description: Set at creation, else the first line of the first message.

cwd.description: Working directory for the core tools.

lastSeq.description: 0 if the session has no events yet.

state.description: running from the user_message that starts a turn until after its turn_ended is sent.

queued.description: Inputs waiting behind the running turn.

waiting.description: The inputs waiting behind the running turn, oldest first (queued of them): what clients show above their input. Absent when none wait.

preview.description: The latest thing said, on one line and cut to about 120 characters: the agent's last message, else the user's.

added.description: Lines added by edits in this session (agent and guests), from their diffs.

removed.description: Lines removed by edits in this session.

parent.description: The session that delegated a task into this one (a subagent working in another directory, e.g. a worktree). Its turns run on the harness it was delegated to.

harness.description: The harness the session's next turn runs on: pi, claude, codex… (/harness).

WaitingInput.description: An input queued behind the running turn. neo takes it into the running turn after its next tool calls (it is logged as user_message then); other harnesses get it when the turn ends.

text.description: What the chat will show: the input's text, or its shown text.

ToolResult.description: A connector result returned to a guest as text ending in [result:ref]. Views draw a tool call whose text carries the ref with this result and the tool's template.

GuestTurn.description: A guest agent finished a task the user gave it directly (/claude …). Rendered to the main agent as <guest agent=… stop=…>result</guest> so it knows what happened.

EditsReverted.description: The user reverted edits the agents had applied (the review card after a turn in edits mode, or a per-edit Revert in review mode for an ACP harness). Rendered to the main agent as <reverted paths="a.ts, b.ts"/> so it knows the files are back as they were.

paths.description: Files restored (or deleted, when the turn created them).

skipped.description: Files left alone because they changed again after the turn's edits.

UserNote.description: The user answered a question with a note for the agent (Tab on a button in a permission_request or choice) and the answer could not reach the agent's tool result: a guest's permission request, a choice. Rendered to the main agent as <note about="...">text</note> with its next prompt. Not shown in the chat (the answered card shows the note).

about.description: What was answered: the question's title and the picked option.

Notice.description: A line for the user in the chat, from the daemon: the outcome of /login, /logout and /accounts, a login URL to open. Never a secret. Not a context event: the agent doesn't see it.

CommandsAvailable.description: The slash commands a harness offers beyond the daemon's own, as it last listed them: Claude Code's and Codex's from their ACP adapters (available_commands_update), neo's from the enabled plugins. The latest event of a harness replaces the earlier ones; an empty list clears it. Views show them in the / menu while the session runs on that harness, after the daemon's own commands, which win on a name clash. /name args is sent as the user's text; the harness runs the command. Not a context event: the agent doesn't see it.

harness.description: Which harness offers them, e.g. claude, codex or neo.

name.description: What follows the slash, e.g. review.

hint.description: What the arguments are, e.g. branch or PR.

SubagentStarted.description: The main agent's delegate call was approved and a subagent starts. Until the matching subagent_ended, events labelled with `agent` are that subagent's work: they stay in the log (and in the per-agent view) but the session's view draws one tool item for the delegation instead of its messages and tool calls. Not a context event.

name.description: The agent definition it runs as (neo with a reviewer's instructions and tools), when it is not the harness itself; what lists show instead of `agent`.

model.description: The model it runs with, when one was chosen for this task or by the user.

cwd.description: The directory it works in, when that is not the session's.

child.description: A subagent working in another directory runs as its own session (parent = this one); its id.

background.description: The delegate call returned at once and the subagent outlives the turn: a turn's end does not close it, and its final reply reaches the main agent as an agent_message.

SubagentEnded.description: The subagent started by subagent_started finished, failed or was stopped.

AgentMessage.description: One agent told another something with send_message, or a background subagent's final reply (`reply`). `from` and `to` are `main` (the session's own agent) or a subagent's id (the one in subagent_started). Not a context event: the daemon delivers it to the recipient itself (appended to its next tool result, or as the turn an idle agent starts).

fromAgent.description: Harness name of the sender, when it is a subagent.

toAgent.description: Harness name of the recipient, when it is a subagent.

reply.description: The sender's final reply: a background subagent finished and this is what it gives back.

PermissionDetail.description: One labelled fact of a permission request, drawn as a highlighted key–value row above the content.

PermissionRequest.description: An agent asks before doing something: a guest running a tool, the main agent running a command, changing or reading a file, starting a guest. Panes show the content (a diff to preview) and the options as buttons (action neo.permit {id, option, note?}); the agent waits until one is picked or the turn is cancelled. Reads of sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials) ask in every approvals mode, with kind read and a title like "Read .env?". In review mode an edit is asked about after it was written: the diff in content, options Keep and Revert (an ACP harness's edit is not held back: the card comes when its completed diff arrives).

kind.description: What kind of action is asked about (edit, execute…), when known.

content.description: What to preview: for an edit, the diff that has not been applied yet.

details.description: Labelled facts shown above the content, e.g. a delegation's harness, model, effort and directory.

PermissionResolved.description: The answer to a permission_request: the picked option, or none when the turn was cancelled.

note.description: What the user added to the answer for the agent ("use tabs instead"); the agent hears it with the tool's result or its next prompt.

SettingChanged.description: The user changed a setting for this session. model, effort, mode: a harness's (/model, /effort, /mode; the last one per harness and option wins, and new sessions start with the user's last choice). harness (harness "neo", value neo, claude or codex…): the harness that runs the session's following turns (/harness); the user's last choice is the default for new sessions (logged at creation when it isn't the daemon's own agent). approvals (harness "neo", value ask, review, edits or auto; /approvals cycles them in that order): ask asks before file edits, commands, starting a guest and guests' requests; review writes each edit right away and then asks Keep or Revert for that edit, and asks for the rest; edits writes edits right away (the user can revert them after the turn) and asks for the rest; auto asks for nothing. Reads are allowed in every mode except sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials), which ask in every mode, as do commands that mention one. Per session, ask unless set. title_model (harness "neo", value "<harness> <model>", "<harness>" for the harness's own default model, or "default" for neo's choice; /title-model): the model that writes session titles. Not per session: the user's last choice applies to every session.

Choice.description: Neo asks the user to pick one of several options (a model, a conversation to resume). Panes show them as buttons (action neo.choose {id, option, note?}).

current.description: The id of the option in effect now, if any.

ChoiceMade.description: The answer to a choice: the picked option, or none when it was dropped (the daemon restarted, or a newer choice replaced it).

note.description: What the user added to the answer for the agent.

Plan.description: An agent's current todo list. Replaces that agent's previous plan as a whole; the newest plan event per agent is its current plan. Not part of the model's context.

agent.description: Set when a guest agent's plan (e.g. claude, codex); absent for the session's own agent.

PlanEntry.description: One todo of a plan (ACP's plan entry).

Usage.description: Latest token and cost numbers of an agent, for status displays. Each event carries the agent's current numbers; consumers keep the newest event per agent. Not part of the model's context. Every number is optional: an agent reports what it knows.

agent.description: Set when a guest agent's numbers (e.g. claude, codex); absent for the session's own agent.

contextUsed.description: Tokens in the agent's context window as of its last request.

contextSize.description: The model's context window in tokens.

cost.description: USD spent by this agent in this session so far (cumulative).

inputTokens.description: Input tokens (including cache reads and writes) summed over this agent's requests in this session.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens summed over this agent's requests in this session.
